preconditions.description: The number of planets is between 1 and 100,000.
The number of Hyperspace™ highways is between 1 and 500,000.
The number of queries is between 1 and 200,000.
Each Hyperspace™ highway connects two different planets.
Each query is for a pair of planets.

postconditions.expression: output consists of Q lines, each containing an integer
postconditions.description: The output should contain the minimal number of Hyperspace™ highways one needs to take to travel from planet a_j to planet b_j for each query.
